message:
The other day, as I watched the weather report, I felt a strange sense of calm wash over me. You see, I've had my fair share of last-minute dashes to the store during storms, only to find the shelves bare and my patience thin. But this time, I had my supplies all lined up like little soldiers: water, snacks, and even a few candles tucked away for ambiance. 

It was a bit of a revelation, really, to be the one who was ready for once instead of scrambling in the chaos. I even found myself feeling a little smug as I sipped my tea while the wind howled outside. 

What’s your little tip for staying prepared during stormy weather? I'd love to hear your tricks!
